detail.name: w: #2011 B usage series
detail.task:
#2011 slice B — the persisted usage SERIES that the token time-plot reads. Branch `feat/2011-usage-series`, PR to main. THE SPEC is the planner's plan at https://github.com/willem445/orrerix/issues/2011#issuecomment-5560124997: sections "Data model", "Files" and "Steps" 2–5 — read it in full, then `doc/design/group-cost-tracking.md` (the usage collector, `compute_group_usage`, `merge_usage_snapshots`, cursors/`CURSOR_REVALIDATE_AFTER`), `doc/design/polled-views.md` (the publisher tier budget — this must NOT widen the 1 s tiers), `crates/loomux-engine/src/obs.rs`/`filehash.rs` (sha2 already a dep), `src-tauri/tests/synccommands.rs` + `tests/groupid.rs` (the scans a new command must pass).

BUILD: (1) `crates/loomux-engine/src/usageseries.rs` (Tauri-free): `SeriesRow` {Sample, Mark} exactly as the plan's JSON, `should_sample(prev, now, bucket)` (one row per key per 5-min bucket ONLY when a counter moved; cumulative values), `parse_series_lines` (per-line fault tolerant like `parse_audit_lines`), `diff_series` (delta never negative: a shrunk cumulative → delta 0 + `reset: true`). Inline `#[cfg(test)]` tests named per the plan's step 2. (2) `UsageSnapshot.block` + `.cli` (`#[serde(default)]`, additive) set in `compute_usage_snapshot`; `series_sample` called once per tick from `compute_group_usage` AFTER `merge_usage_snapshots` (same snapshots — no second transcript read); `append_series_line` on `append_ledger_line`'s single-`write_all` pattern to `<group>/usage-series.jsonl` (one writer, never rotated, never rebuilt from audit). (3) `orch_usage_series(group_id, since_ms)` `#[tauri::command]` through `read_command` (constraint 10), group id parsed at the boundary (constraint 6), returning rows + `agents: [{id, block, cli, role, session, task}]`; typed wrapper `usageSeries(groupId, sinceMs)` in `src/orchestration.ts` (constraint 5) and `AgentUsage` gaining `block`/`cli`. (4) `src-tauri/src/orchestration/tuningfp.rs`: `fingerprint(repo)` over `.orrerix/workflow.yml`, `.github/agents/*.md`, `.claude/skills/**` (sorted, depth ≤ 6, files > 1 MB skipped → `fp_partial`), `CLAUDE.md`, `.orrerix/lessons.md`, + `CARGO_PKG_VERSION`; at most once per bucket on the publisher thread, NEVER the GUI thread; a `mark` row when it differs from the last mark. (5) Integration tests in `src-tauri/tests/orchestration.rs` per steps 3–5 (append at EOF: mind the `);`+`}` trailing-token conflict rule). (6) `doc/design/token-charts.md` (new): the series file is a PERSISTED SCHEMA and `orch_usage_series` a COMMAND SIGNATURE — both contracts, the bucket/mark rules, the cursor-reset clamp, the coverage note; pointer from group-cost-tracking.md; `docs/orchestration.md` one paragraph. Render every edited list/table through `gh api -X POST markdown -f mode=gfm -F text=@file`.

CONSTRAINTS: no local cargo (CI is the build — draft PR early; `rustfmt --check --edition 2021` on changed .rs is the only local Rust check); no new crates (Windows-10 baseline, constraint 2); mod.rs INSERT anchors above the `///` block never above the `fn` (#1229); the `mod.rs` hunk around `compute_usage_snapshot`/`compute_group_usage` is a conflict surface — keep it minimal. DEFINITION OF DONE: every new test seen RED at base (command + failure line in the agent layer), green at head; both scans green; every number measured at base and head; no tool footer / session URL; `gh pr create` (ready when green); `Part of #2011` (never Closes); `report(done, ref: PR)`.
